Phase 66 impl @ 6295abf (branch phase/roadmap-dependency-problems-name-their-line). gate: see entry @ 6295abf — I did not run the full suite; this gate run is also the first full suite on the repaired .venv (pytest 9.1.1).

What changed — tagteam/roadmap.py: RoadmapPhase.line and .dep_lines, both field(compare=False), dep_lines with default_factory=dict, appended after suffix; _split_dep_refs() returns (ref, section line offset), first occurrence wins; parse_roadmap() computes heading_line from match.start() and records dep_lines with setdefault at the moment a RESOLVED value is first appended; validate_graph() uses n = dep_lines.get(dep, 0) and adds ' (line N)' only when n > 0. No change to reference splitting/resolution, identity problems or cycle messages.

Your guidance, as built: compare=False on both fields — test_location_is_not_part_of_a_phases_identity parses the same phase at two different line positions and asserts equality with each other and with a hand-built RoadmapPhase (the existing parsed-vs-hand-built assertion at tests/test_roadmap.py:92 passes untouched); alias duplicates — test_first_line_wins_for_repeats_and_for_aliases_of_one_phase has 'ghost' repeated verbatim on a later line AND 'Phase 1' / 'Alpha' / 'alpha' across two lines, asserting dep_lines == {ghost: 5, alpha: 5, other: 7}; n > 0 rather than truthiness, with a dep_lines={'ghost': 0} case asserting no '(line 0)'; the Scope paragraph's worktree example is corrected in the phase doc.

Other tests (tests/test_roadmap.py::TestDependencyProblemLines): the bugalizer line reproduced — both problems end '(line 11)', roadmap check exits 1; self-dependency with its line and a resolved reference's dep_lines; CRLF input and a Phase-63 placeholder heading between phases give the same numbers; positional construction RoadmapPhase('a','A','Not Started',1,[...],'') still works and yields the exact old strings.

Existing expectations changed: TWO, not the one I predicted — TestGraphValidation::test_unknown_self_cycle_all_listed ('(line 3)' twice) and TestDynamicAdvance::test_invalid_roadmap_pauses (pause_reason '… (line 5)'); both parse from text.

Criterion 7, read-only: tagteam roadmap check over the 39 registered projects outside Northstar — all ok. (clearpath-cloud was unregistered today at the arbiter's request and neither Northstar repo was run.)

Verified by me: focused only — tests/test_roadmap.py + tests/test_worktree.py 143 passed.

GATE: PASS | scope 3 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2148 passed, 5 skipped, 7m46s)
checked: HEAD 6295abf

Approved at 6295abf. The implementation matches the approved scope: parsed unknown/self-dependency errors carry their 1-based source line, while hand-built phases retain the old strings and identity/cycle diagnostics are unchanged. Both new fields are excluded from equality and appended after existing positional fields. First-occurrence locations survive both verbatim deduplication and alias resolution. The offset calculation agrees with section boundaries; regressions cover CRLF, placeholder sections, multiple references on a line, alias repeats, equality, positional compatibility, CLI output, and watcher pause_reason propagation.

The two existing expectation changes are justified and documented. Focused verification: tests/test_roadmap.py, 120 passed. git diff --check 7b4b4e8 clean. Accepted Gatekeeper PASS at the same HEAD: 2148 passed, 5 skipped, including the first full suite on the repaired venv. No full-suite rerun. No outstanding review findings.
